An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''governor''' ruled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fallex]]. The [[Governor/Legends|governor]] oppressed the natives to Fallex, which caused uprising within the natives. With the assistance of the [[Ardan resistance]], the governor and the Imperial occupation of Fallex became eradicated.<ref name="OAA1" />
